title: 28-byte record range erase
summary: Recovered thiscall vector range erasure at VA 0x4b2480: clear fast path, forward assignment compaction, logical-end update and explicit iterator output. Original instructions and application-frame caller at 0x4a1090 establish a three-pointer container and 28-byte stride; record field meanings remain opaque.
test_description: Direct GCC i386 thiscall comparisons with the original for every valid subrange of lengths 0 through 12, including empty, whole, prefix, suffix, middle and overlapping compaction. Checks return-slot identity, output iterator, all container fields, every allocation word including unchanged tail, and surrounding sentinels. Also compares output-slot aliases to each container field and a null empty triple. Installs test FS and checks head restoration after each original call. Local validation passed with the 116-byte oracle verified against Game.exe and linked at VA 0x4b2480. Implementation also compiled using pinned MSVC2013 at O2.
known_limits: Record field types and ownership semantics are unresolved; only opaque 28-byte assignment is established.
Only valid ordered record-boundary ranges and writable iterator outputs are supported; invalid ranges retain original unchecked preconditions.
No byte-match claim; portable struct assignment need not reproduce original SSE instruction selection.
No exceptions or OS behavior is involved in this routine.
Local MSVC O1 and O2 /Oy- attempts were blocked by compiler D8037 (cannot create temporary il file); those configurations require trusted coordinator validation.
